        *   "system" -> `SystemMessage`
        *   "function" (with "name" and "content") -> `FunctionMessage`

*   Update `libs/partners/groq/langchain_groq/__init__.py`:

## New package: `libs/partners/groq/`

**`langchain_groq/chat_models.py`** — the core implementation:

- **`ChatGroq`** (subclass of `BaseChatModel`):
  - `model_name` field with `alias="model"` and `allow_population_by_field_name = True`, so both `ChatGroq(model=...)` and `ChatGroq(model_name=...)` set `model_name`.
  - `groq_api_key: Optional[SecretStr]` with `alias="api_key"` — stored as a `SecretStr` (kept out of `repr`/`str`) and loaded from env `GROQ_API_KEY`.
  - Serialization: `is_lc_serializable() → True`, `lc_secrets → {"groq_api_key": "GROQ_API_KEY"}`, `get_lc_namespace`, `lc_attributes`. The `SecretStr` is excluded from dumps and reloaded from `secrets_map`.
  - `build_extra` root-validator uses `build_extra_kwargs` to route unknown kwargs into `model_kwargs` with a `UserWarning`, and raises `ValueError` for duplicate keys or when a named field/`model` appears in `model_kwargs`.
  - `validate_environment` raises `ValueError` when `streaming=True` and `n > 1` (and `n < 1`), and builds patchable `client` / `async_client` (`exclude=True` fields) from `groq.Groq` / `groq.AsyncGroq`.
  - Full sync/async/streaming support (`_generate`, `_agenerate`, `_stream`, `_astream`).
- **`_convert_dict_to_message`** maps `user→HumanMessage`, `assistant→AIMessage`, `system→SystemMessage`, `function→FunctionMessage` (plus `tool`/`chat` fallbacks).

**`langchain_groq/__init__.py`** — exports `ChatGroq` with `__all__ = ["ChatGroq"]`.

Also added `pyproject.toml`, `README.md`, and `py.typed`.
